messages.subject: opts and tick labels
parts:
I think there is a small error in the text for ?opts.

The help text says:

axis.text.x x axis label
axis.text.y y axis label
axis.title.x horizontal tick labels
axis.title.y vertical tick labels

I think that text and title are reversed. That is, axis.text.x refers
to the label at the tick mark and axis.title.x refers to the overall
label for the axis.
